I've tried every approach: raw movement in all 8 directions with varying durations, the pathfinder to multiple targets, and interacting with E in all facings. The body is embedded in the Notice Board at (2,7) and the game engine refuses to move it off that blocked tile — the pathfinder explicitly reports "in the way: Notice Board at (2,7)" for the start tile.

I cannot reach the Wood, Stone, or the Workbench, so I cannot craft the Crown.

I'm stuck: my body is embedded in the Notice Board at (2,7) and cannot move off that blocked tile, so I can't gather materials or reach the workbench to craft the Crown.
